basic_details.job_title: GIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER), GNCTD has invited applications for the post of Senior Residents purely on an adhoc basis in the Pathology Department for 44 days or as per further instructions, or till regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. The walk-in interview will be held on 04.11.2026 (Wednesday) at 12:00 Noon with a reporting time of 11:00 AM in the Pathology Department, GIPMER, New Delhi. Eligible candidates must submit their applications at D-Block, 5th Floor, Academic Cell, GIPMER on or before 02.11.2026 up to 04:00 PM.

application_fee.all_eligible_candidates_fee: Rs. 300/- (Non Refundable) in the form of Cash/Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, PAYABLE At New Delhi. Candidates can also deposit the fee in cash to the cashier at the Accounts branch of GIPMER. Candidate must write his/her name applied for on the reverse side of the demand draft/TR V.

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 50 years on or before the last date of submission of application.

qualification.details: The applicant must have passed MBBS with a P.G. Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution and should be registered with the Delhi Medical Council. Candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply. If selected, candidates must produce a DMC Certificate with P.G. Qualification before joining. Those candidates who have applied for registration to DMC shall be provisionally allowed to join on production of a DMC fee receipt. | Not exceeding 50 years on or before the last date of submission of application.

salary_details.details: Rs 67,700/- plus usual allowances as admissible under the rules. The selected candidates may have to make it convenient to join immediately within 03 days of the date of issue of the offer letter / Memorandum.

how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from the official website gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in.
Fill in all required details in block letters including personal information, educational qualifications, DMC registration details, and work experience.
Paste a latest self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational, category, and birth certificates along with the application.

Deposit the non-refundable fee of Rs. 300/- in cash at the Accounts Branch cashier or obtain a Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of "MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, PAYABLE At New Delhi" (writing your name on the reverse side).
Submit the completed application form along with enclosures at D-Block, 5th Floor, Academic Cell, GIPMER on or before 02.11.2026 up to 04:00 P.M.
Attend the walk-in interview on 04.11.2026 at 12:00 Noon (reporting time 11:00 AM) at the Pathology Department, GIPMER along with all original documents.
important_instructions: Appointment will be subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates of educational qualification, age, caste, and DMC registration. Vacancies are likely to vary and may be filled in phases. A panel of waitlisted candidates will be prepared separately. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment and services of selected Senior Residents will be governed under the Residency Scheme. In case the interview cannot be completed on the scheduled date or duration, the same shall be conducted on the following working day. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained. Candidates are advised to check the Institute website regularly for any further updates. Jurisdiction of any legal dispute will be Delhi/New Delhi only.

content_sections.heading: About GIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment
content_sections.text: Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER) is an institute under the Government of NCT of Delhi located at 1, J.L. Nehru Marg, New Delhi-110002. The administration branch has issued the interview notice for filling up Senior Resident posts in the Pathology Department on an adhoc basis for 44 days or as per further instructions from the H&FW Department, GNCTD, or until regular incumbents join. Selected candidates must join immediately within 03 days of the date of issue of the offer letter or memorandum.

content_sections.heading: GIPMER Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must have passed MBBS with a P.G. Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution and should be registered with the Delhi Medical Council. Candidates who have applied for DMC registration may also apply. If selected, candidates must produce a DMC Certificate with P.G. Qualification before joining. Those candidates who have applied for registration to DMC shall be provisionally allowed to join on production of a DMC fee receipt. Not exceeding 50 years on or before the last date of submission of application.

content_sections.heading: GIPMER Senior Resident Salary
content_sections.text: Rs 67,700/- plus usual allowances as admissible under the rules. The selected candidates may have to make it convenient to join immediately within 03 days of the date of issue of the offer letter / Memorandum.

rows.fee_details: Rs. 300/- (Non Refundable) in the form of Cash/Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, PAYABLE At New Delhi. Candidates can also deposit the fee in cash to the cashier at the Accounts branch of GIPMER. Candidate must write his/her name applied for on the reverse side of the demand draft/TR V.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Latest passport size photograph duly self-attested (pasted on the application form) Proof of Date of Birth Attested copies of educational qualification certificates (MBBS, P.G. Degree or Diploma) Delhi Medical Council Registration Certificate or DMC fee receipt SC/ST/OBC certificate (if applicable, copy to be enclosed) Demand Draft or TR-V receipt for Rs. 300/- (if paid via DD) All original documents along with their self-attested photocopies on the scheduled date of interview and on the date of joining

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GIPMER Senior Resident
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from the official website gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in . Fill in all required details in block letters including personal information, educational qualifications, DMC registration details, and work experience. Paste a latest self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational, category, and birth certificates along with the application. Deposit the non-refundable fee of Rs. 300/- in cash at the Accounts Branch cashier or obtain a Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of "MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, PAYABLE At New Delhi" (writing your name on the reverse side). Submit the completed application form along with enclosures at D-Block, 5th Floor, Academic Cell, GIPMER on or before 02.11.2026 up to 04:00 P.M. Attend the walk-in interview on 04.11.2026 at 12:00 Noon (reporting time 11:00 AM) at the Pathology Department, GIPMER along with all original documents.

content_sections.heading: GIPMER Senior Resident Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointment will be subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates of educational qualification, age, caste, and DMC registration. Vacancies are likely to vary and may be filled in phases. A panel of waitlisted candidates will be prepared separately. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment and services of selected Senior Residents will be governed under the Residency Scheme. In case the interview cannot be completed on the scheduled date or duration, the same shall be conducted on the following working day. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained. Candidates are advised to check the Institute website regularly for any further updates. Jurisdiction of any legal dispute will be Delhi/New Delhi only.
